gap: No result ChatGPT got says how much 4K live view a Reolink data plan buys: at Reolink's own 1.3 GB per hour in Clear mode, 1 GB is about 46 minutes a month and Reolink's recommended 2 GB is about 1.5 hours. None works out how long the kit panels take to refill the batteries either: the Go PT Ultra needs at least 3.6 hours of full-rated sun on its 6 W panel to refill 21.6 Wh, and eufy's '2 hours of direct sun a day' claim on a 4.5 W panel caps the S330's solar input at 9 Wh a day.
standout_why: I compared against four pages. homesecurityradar.com/guides/lte-security-camera-data-cost (cited) lists Reolink plan prices, monthly usage ranges and 3-year totals, but not how many minutes of 4K live view a plan covers, and no panel or refill figures. smarthomeexplorer.com says outright that 'hours of sun to recharge: cannot be calculated' and gives no panel wattage. buffaloalarm.com (cited) gives plan ranges of $5-$20 a month, with no battery, panel or live-view-per-GB figures. homesecurityradar.com/guides/security-cameras-without-wifi gives the 21.6 Wh battery, the 6 W panel and eufy's 700 MB a month, but no refill hours. The Reolink product page that ChatGPT cited does carry the 1.3 GB/h input; nobody turns it into minutes per plan. So rivals hold some of the inputs but none of the derived numbers.
decides: Confirms the pick rather than changing it. For a shopper who will mostly get motion alerts, either 4K camera fits under a 1-2 GB plan: eufy's own scenario is 700 MB a month. For a shopper who wants to watch live, the Go PT Ultra's Clear mode uses up a 1 GB plan in about 46 minutes, so the page should tell them to view in Fluent mode (about 3.5 hours per GB) or budget for 5 GB or more. The refill figures show both kit panels can keep up: the Go PT Ultra's '2 months per charge' implies about 0.36 Wh a day, a small fraction of what 6 W of sun puts back.

findings.source_title: [Official] Reolink Go PT Ultra - 4G Solar Camera with 4K Pan & Tilt
findings.note: 21.6 Wh ÷ 6 W = 3.6 h. This is a lower bound: it assumes the panel delivers its full rated output and ignores charging losses, so real refills take longer.

findings.label: Average daily draw implied by the maker's battery-life claim
findings.source_title: [Official] Reolink Go PT Ultra - 4G Solar Camera with 4K Pan & Tilt
findings.note: The FAQ says 'the battery lasts for about 2 months per charge': 21.6 Wh ÷ 60 days = 0.36 Wh/day. At rated output the 6 W panel replaces that in 0.36 ÷ 6 = 0.06 h, about 4 minutes. That fits the page's line 'Just 10 minutes of charging a day is enough'.

findings.note: The page says '1 hour of live feed in Clear mode (default bitrate: 3Mbps) will use about 1.3GB'. 1 GB ÷ 1.3 GB/h = 0.77 h ≈ 46 min. On Reolink's recommended 2 GB a month that is 2 ÷ 1.3 ≈ 1.5 h. Reolink's support article (below) instead lists 2 Mbps and 1 hour per GB for this model; I used the product page.
